Ferrocast converts between 275 format pairs across 46 input formats in nine families. All conversions run locally; macOS tools come first, and ffmpeg, LibreOffice and cwebp are optional and used only when installed.

Drag a file and tap <kbd>⇧</kbd>, press <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> on a file result, run Convert Files, or press <kbd>⌥</kbd> <kbd>↵</kbd> on a file result. Pick the target format; the result is written next to the original and never overwrites it.

In the tables below, a target followed by a tool name needs that optional tool installed; every other pair uses tools that ship with macOS.

## Images

8 inputs, 57 pairs.

| From | To |
|---|---|
| JPEG (`jpg`) | `png`, `webp` *(cwebp)*, `heic`, `tiff`, `avif`, `bmp`, `pdf` |
| PNG (`png`) | `jpg`, `webp` *(cwebp)*, `heic`, `tiff`, `avif`, `bmp`, `pdf` |
| WebP (`webp`) | `jpg`, `png`, `heic`, `tiff`, `avif`, `bmp`, `pdf` |
| HEIC (`heic`) | `jpg`, `png`, `webp` *(cwebp)*, `tiff`, `avif`, `bmp`, `pdf` |
| TIFF (`tiff`) | `jpg`, `png`, `webp` *(cwebp)*, `heic`, `avif`, `bmp`, `pdf` |
| Other (`svg`) | `jpg`, `png`, `webp` *(cwebp)*, `heic`, `tiff`, `avif`, `bmp`, `pdf` |
| AVIF (`avif`) | `jpg`, `png`, `webp` *(cwebp)*, `heic`, `tiff`, `bmp`, `pdf` |
| BMP (`bmp`) | `jpg`, `png`, `webp` *(cwebp)*, `heic`, `tiff`, `avif`, `pdf` |

## Pairs that need an optional tool

- **cwebp**: 7 pairs
- **ffmpeg**: 92 pairs
- **LibreOffice**: 60 pairs

:::caution[Limits]
Layout fidelity is not checked; RAR is tested only with a hand-built archive because the bundled `unrar` is x86-only; `.pages` is written in the iWork '09 format and was opened with LibreOffice, not with Pages.
:::

## Status

**Tested.** The real-file test runs every pair and reads the result back (text inside documents and sheets, image width, media duration).
